verdict.rationale: Asaas documents payment links as a feature [asaas-docs-2] and an Asaas-hosted checkout/payment page where payers choose among enabled methods [asaas-docs-13, asaas-docs-19]. However, these mentions are framed around the API, and nothing shows a founder creating and sharing a link from the dashboard without code. Missing for 10: evidence of dashboard-based no-code link creation, a sharing workflow, and immediate go-live without integration, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
